text:
Stuttgart’s median asking rents sit at 15.98 €/m², a modest 0.1 % rise year‑on‑year and 15.3 % growth over the past five years, placing the city third among the 37 most expensive markets. The asking premium over existing rents is 54 %, with a typical 60 m² unit costing about 959 € per month.

The market remains balanced but tight: listings spend an average of 29 days on the market, and only 23 % are let within a week. Vacancy is low at 1.8 %, while rent‑burden for two residents reaches 18.3 % and population growth over five years is slightly negative (‑0.1 %).

The model‑based forecast projects median asking rents of 16.7 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 16.35 €/m² and 17.22 €/m² – a 4.5 % increase.
